title: Building an living pirate world with AI
author: Left-Prompt7557
selftext:
Over the past few months or even years, I've been playing around with procedural generation and open world games, creating various different mechanics and systems. A bit more recently however, a group of friends and I have been turning this collection of sandbox ideas and experiments into *Tales of the Eighth Sea,* an endless nautical world, where people live their lives, factions go to war and greater threats lurk in the deep...

The engine is Unity and the main coding LLM we use is Opus 5.5. Graphics are a human/AI workflow where initial human sketches are turned into 2D and 3D assets with ChatGPT and Meshy.



Last week we released our first public playtest and have spent the week burning credits trying to address all the really helpful feedback we received! Among other things, we've substantially reworked the opening tutorial, improved naval combat and settlement capture, and made quite a few visual improvements.

There's still an enormous amount to do, particularly with the storyline and animations, but it's finally starting to feel like a game rather than an endless series of experiments.

**If you fancied taking to the Eighth Sea, we would love to hear your feedback! The free playtest is available here** [**https://walnut-studio.itch.io/tales-of-the-eighth-sea**](https://walnut-studio.itch.io/tales-of-the-eighth-sea)
